# AIS Platform (ais-platform.dev) — Semantic Interface Layer (SIL v0.3) & STF Ecosystem

> Official agent-facing index for AIS Platform by Vladimir Sitnikov (Architect & Technical Founder).
> Every page on this domain provides both a browser-viewable SIL layer (`.../sil/`) and a raw `text/plain` SIL document (`.../sil.txt` and `.../index.sil`) in Semantic Text Format (STF / SIL v0.3).
